legal.draftNote: This document is a draft and will be reviewed by a person before the beta.

privacy.p1: Meri reads your email and calendar only to detect commitments, plan your work and infer billable time. It does not store email bodies: only ids, minimal metadata and a quoted snippet of up to 200 characters.
privacy.p2: Meri never sends email on your behalf: it only creates drafts. It does not modify meetings with third parties without your explicit confirmation.
privacy.p3: Data obtained from Google is used solely for the features you see in the app, in line with Google's Limited Use policy. It is never used for advertising or to train general models.
privacy.p4: You can export and delete all your data from the Control centre. Connections can be revoked at any time.
privacy.p5: Contact: privacy@ on Meri's domain (domain pending).

terms.p1: Meri is an assistance tool. Legal dates and procedural deadlines must always be verified with your own professional judgement.
terms.p2: Every automatic action is recorded and can be undone. High-impact actions require your confirmation.
terms.p3: The service is offered on a 14-day trial; published plans apply afterwards.
terms.p4: Contact: support@ on Meri's domain (domain pending).
